definitions.ttft: First nonempty SSE content block, completed requests only.
definitions.request_tpot: Visible per-token timestamps. Never inferred from SSE blocks.
definitions.sse_span_per_token: First–last SSE content span divided by reported tokens minus one.
definitions.throughput: Completions / first-send to last-terminal-outcome observation seconds.
definitions.completion_fraction_planned: Successful responses divided by all planned requests.
definitions.feature_bytes: E→P frame totals sum each ZMQ receiver copy. Image/DeepStack bytes count unique tensor rows. Physical link bytes require another capture.
definitions.kv_pages: Sum of verified rank-local pages. Same logical positions can appear on each rank.
definitions.kv_bytes: Engine payload counters paired with D checksum evidence. No link-byte inference.
definitions.missing: Unlogged requests and unavailable counters are tracked separately from failures.
